name: showcase
description: Every plugin component in one gallery: each view node, field, span and button style, plus flags, toasts, context, session environment, secrets, events, host commands and its own thread and terminal. For plugin authors and for testing the host.

commands.name: ping
commands.title: Ping Showcase
commands.description: Answer pong with a running count: a command with no args and no confirm.

commands.name: boom
commands.title: Blow Up Something
commands.description: Pretend to destroy something: a command that asks first, with an arg in its confirm text. Nothing is deleted.
commands.confirm: Blow up {what}? Nothing is really deleted.

commands.name: flag
commands.title: Flag Thread
commands.description: Raise an attention or error flag on a thread, or clear it (level none).

args.name: level
args.description: attention, error, or none to clear

args.name: reason
args.description: The flag's reason (one line, up to 80 characters)

args.name: until-seen
args.description: Clear it when the thread is opened

commands.name: gate
commands.title: Turn Showcase Gate On or Off
commands.description: Set or remove the showcase.on fact for a thread (or everywhere); the Gated tab exists only where it is true.
